teaser: The US ground stop is a case for town planner teams that certify every line, and for AI that makes that work scale.
core_idea: After a network update preceded a reboot, crash and five-hour US ground stop on 13 November 2026, a LinkedIn post blamed AI-written code. The evidence so far points to a software update and patches on an old network, with no evidence yet of AI involvement. Whatever wrote the change, such systems belong to town planners: every line read, certified and tested by an experienced multidisciplinary team. AI belongs around the shipped code, in understanding, connecting, aligning, testing and the non-functional requirements, where it raises quality and resilience.
